fact: Decree 2022-092/PR/MCT of 4 May 2022 organises the ADN, a public industrial and commercial body under the Ministry of Commerce and Tourism, and calls it the national reference body for drawing up standards, charged with preparing and approving standards, certification of conformity and accreditation of conformity-assessment bodies; no IT or data standard is named.

fact: Law 100/AN/20/8th L of 7 January 2021 creates the Agence Djiboutienne des Normes et de la Qualite (ADN) as a public industrial and commercial body attached to the Ministry of Commerce, the national reference body for drawing up standards, in charge of preparing and approving standards and certifying conformity to them; the passages seen name no IT or data standard.
